This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, 
 which must be carried out from four to six years as indicated by Y4-6 in the 
 title block.

This first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Migid Aly, tested by eng. Sayed 
 El-Ashry, revised by eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar EDEPC inspection 
 quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Ghaffar Al Aresh PS general 
 director.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and certified 
 by accountant Mahmoud Soliman, EDEPC General director of admin, 
 financial inspection and supervisor of inspection and quality control head 
 sector.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc
Switch down the generator and exciter.

Safety and healthy tools as safety helmet, safety shoes ... 
 etc
Blower and brushes
DC 500 V megger
Special tools
Fine cloth for cleaning purpose

Check the insulation for the AC exciter winding (rotating armature, magnetic 
 poles) must be more than 1mΩ at DC 500 V megger.

Cleaning the silicon rectifiers, heat sink, condenser, resistor and rectifier 
 ring.
Check if the clamping bolts of lead connections are loose.

Check the silicon rectifiers under the condition that the main generator field 
 winding is detached from the rotary rectifiers (remove the leads shown in the 
 figure).

Check the reverse resistance of each silicon rectifier (measure the reverse 
 resistance between B and heat sink and between heat sink A and C in turn an 
 shown in the figure 1. the normal value for the reverse resistance of each 
 silicon rectifier is more than 0.1 MΩ by 500 V megger.
Disconnected ground on the generator winding
The circuit breaker of the generator on the service position.
Lift up the safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area.
Finish the work permit.
